meta.title: INDEX 350 — W3 Performance Review & W4 Candidate Selection
meta.policy: This batch reviews W3 only when real finalized GSC/indexation outputs exist. It never fabricates metrics and never publishes W4 candidates.

composition.note: Soft target uses all 18 remaining Series, 7 non-risk Models, and 25 Conditions. Adaptive fill may use reserve Conditions if a Series/Model is blocked, but group minima must still pass.

selectionRules: Only HOLD_PLANNED candidates from B_SERIES, C_MODEL, and D_CONDITION are eligible.
Real W3 Observation state ROUND4_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE is required before SELECT decisions are emitted.
Candidate parent must already be LIVE, except an explicit same-wave MODEL may depend on a selected B_SERIES parent in W4.
If a candidate parent is one of the W3 observed URLs, it must be indexed and free of ownership-review risk.
W3 cluster health may influence score but does not invent candidate-specific performance.
Static ownership-risk URLs are blocked until manual review.
Condition cluster minima prevent W4 from becoming one-condition-family heavy.
No candidate is published, indexed, added to sitemap, or canonicalized by this batch.
No automatic W4 release, merge, redirect, noindex, or canonical switch.
